588 class _CommentSpec:
589     def __init__(self, full_prefixes, inline_prefixes):
590         full_patterns = (
591             # prefix at the beginning of a line
592             fr'^({re.escape(prefix)}).*'
593             for prefix in full_prefixes
594         )
595         inline_patterns = (
596             # prefix at the beginning of the line or following a space
597             fr'(^|\s)({re.escape(prefix)}.*)'
598             for prefix in inline_prefixes
599         )
600         self.pattern = re.compile('|'.join(itertools.chain(full_patterns, inline_patterns)))
601 
602     def strip(self, text):
603         return self.pattern.sub('', text).rstrip()
604 
605     def wrap(self, text):
606         return _Line(text, self)

621             (?:\s+(?:(?!{delim})\S)+)*)    # optionally more words

1166         st.optname, vi, optval = mo.group('option', 'vi', 'value')

1171             (st.sectname, st.optname) in st.elements_added):
